style_profiles.name: Aurora maritime intrigue
style_profiles.description: Project-wide style for tense harbor investigation prose.
style_profiles.guidance: Use concrete maritime details, restrained suspicion, and concise sentences. Preserve authored names, quantities, and state terms exactly.
positive_examples: Rain silvered the sealed ledger while the harbor watch counted every departing hull.

style_profiles.name: Opening urgency
style_profiles.description: Higher-tension override for the opening Scene.
style_profiles.guidance: Keep the maritime precision of the project style but shorten beats and foreground immediate danger.
positive_examples: The blockade bell struck once. Mara was already running.

style_profiles.name: Luna harbor test
style_profiles.description: Visible test profile for exercising Style Rewriter requests with the project-default provider and gpt-5.6-luna model.
style_profiles.guidance: Polish the selected prose into crisp maritime suspense. Keep every authored fact, proper name, quantity, quotation, and state reference unchanged.
positive_examples: The harbor bell cut through the rain; every chain on the quay answered with a colder note.

agent_memories.title: Harbor terminology
agent_memories.instruction: Keep authored maritime ranks and harbor terms exact instead of replacing them with generic synonyms.
agent_memories.rationale: Reviewed project terminology should remain stable across rewrites.

agent_memories.title: Opening rhythm
agent_memories.instruction: Use short clauses immediately before physical danger while retaining the restrained project voice.
agent_memories.rationale: The author reviewed this rhythm for the opening Scene.

agent_memories.title: Ledger choice constraint
agent_memories.instruction: Keep the sealed ledger explicit and phrase Mara's decision as a direct action.
agent_memories.rationale: This reviewed constraint belongs only to the selected Dialogue option.

agent_memories.title: Термины гавани
agent_memories.instruction: Сохраняй русские названия должностей и морские термины без замены синонимами.

agent_memories.title: Ритм первой сцены
agent_memories.instruction: Используй короткие фразы перед непосредственной опасностью, сохраняя сдержанный тон.

agent_memories.title: Реплика о реестре
agent_memories.instruction: Сохраняй формулировку про запечатанный реестр и делай решение персонажа прямым.
agent_memories.rationale: Проверенное ограничение для конкретной реплики диалога.

agent_memories.title: Blockade planning assumption
agent_memories.instruction: Treat the blockade route as intentionally dangerous when explaining issues, but preserve deterministic evidence.
agent_memories.rationale: Explicit Canon copy reviewed by the author.

agent_memories.title: Допущение о блокаде
agent_memories.instruction: Считай опасность маршрута через блокаду авторским замыслом при объяснении, но не изменяй детерминированные доказательства.
agent_memories.rationale: Явная копия для проверки канона, подтверждённая автором.

agent_memories.title: Blockade planning assumption
agent_memories.instruction: Treat the blockade route as intentionally dangerous when explaining options, but preserve deterministic findings.
agent_memories.rationale: Explicit Impact copy reviewed by the author.

agent_memories.title: Допущение о блокаде
agent_memories.instruction: Считай опасность маршрута через блокаду авторским замыслом при объяснении вариантов, но не изменяй детерминированные результаты.
agent_memories.rationale: Явная копия для анализа влияния, подтверждённая автором.
